title: Clear Digits
summary: Given a string s , repeatedly remove the first digit and the closest non-digit character to its left, if such a non-digit character exists.
statement: Given a string s , repeatedly remove the first digit and the closest non-digit character to its left, if such a non-digit character exists. Continue this process until all digits are removed. Return the resulting string after all digits have been removed.
constraints: Process s from left to right.
Each digit removes itself and the closest remaining nondigit character to its left.
The input guarantees a nondigit is available for every digit; return the final string.
hints: Remaining nondigits to the left are naturally stored in encounter order.
A digit must remove the most recent such character, which is the top of a stack.
Push nondigits and pop once for digits, then join the stack.
The stack top is always the closest character not already removed, matching each operation.
editorial: The stack top is always the closest character not already removed, matching each operation.

tests.explanation: No digit appears, so the string remains abc.
Three removes b and four then removes c, leaving the empty string.
